steps.title: Start with 2 pieces
steps.instruction: Join 2 pieces (A, B), as the animation shows. Page 4 of the IKEA manual shows this step.

faq.answer: This guide doesn’t show fittings for the TOBIAS chair. Page 4 of the paper manual shows which ones to use and how many.
The blue parts: A (piece, about 51 cm), B (piece, about 57 cm). Watch where they go in the animation.
Sizes are approximate: this model has no real measurements, so it is shown about 82 cm tall.
